For larger size inputs, we need at 3-4 passes to make this PR take effect, but currently we're limited at 2. The problems lies in we need at least two passes for multi inline -- one for inline and invoke, and one for inline param, so if we do inline at pass two, there won't be a chance to inline param.
I'll profile the time and the size with another PR.
Alternatively, we can run DCE on the end. I'm not sure how much performance difference it will show
With some simple tests, I believe 3 passes + DCE or 4 passes would be most optimal.

issue_context.title: Cannot inline variable declared in condition
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

They will be treated as `cond_init` while they're not.

### Input code

```typescript
export function foo(flag) {
    if (flag) {
        var a = 10
        console.log(a)
    }
}
```
or
```js
export function foo(flag) {
    if (flag) return
    var a = 10
    console.log(a)
}
```
